repo.description:
### Impact

When a Nextcloud user account is disabled, their public shares are correctly revoked at the primary /s/{token} endpoint but remain accessible through alternate public endpoints. This allows external recipients who possess the share token to continue reading files and, for editable shares, modifying content even after the share owner's account has been disabled. 


### Patches


It is recommended that the Nextcloud Server is upgraded to 32.0.13 or 33.0.7 or 34.0.2
It is recommended that the Nextcloud Enterprise Server is upgraded to 30.0.17.12 or 31.0.14.8 or 32.0.13 or 33.0.7 or 34.0.2
### Workarounds

<!-- Remove not applicable sections -->

* Delete disabled users

### References
